narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Practice Lock, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ahh, my practice lock has arrived.The Syndicate here have been plotting to turn this place into a prison like it once was. I already know that at least one orc is currently being held here. Maybe more. I don't intend to be another, but I intend to be more prepared than the last time if they catch me off guard.
narrative.requestItemsText: I watched this whole place get burned to the ground and that keep toppled over. It was glorious.Never expected a group of bandits try to use this place as a base of operations.
